```{r, echo = FALSE, include = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

options(scipen = 999)

class_data <- file_check |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  dplyr::rename_with(~ ifelse(. == "report_year" | . == "year", "report_year", .)) |> 
  dplyr::rename_with(~ ifelse(. == "classification_of_energy_delivered_to_ultimate_consumers", "customer_type", .)) |> 
  dplyr::rename_with(~ ifelse(. == "megawatt_hours", "mwh_delivered", .)) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ ifelse(. == "number_of_customers_at_end_of_year", "customer_count", .)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(utility_id = as.numeric(utility_id))

#connect to data warehouse
db <- RPostgreSQL::dbConnect(RPostgreSQL::PostgreSQL(),
                 dbname = dbname, 
                 host = host, 
                 port = port, 
                 user = user, 
                 password = password)

```

```{sql connection=db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "utility_table"}

SELECT DISTINCT utility_name, mn_utility_id AS utility_id
FROM energy.utility_info 

```

Check for duplicate entries
```{r, echo = FALSE}
dup_check <- class_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(utility_id = as.character(utility_id), 
                report_year = as.character(report_year)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(row_id = paste(utility_id, customer_type, report_year, sep = "_")) |> 
                  dplyr::group_by(row_id) |>
  dplyr::mutate(count = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::filter(count > 1)

if(nrow(dup_check) == 0){

  print("No duplicates found")

} else{

  print("The following rows are duplicates")

  DT::datatable(dup_check)

}
```

Check for invalid customer classes

```{sql connection = db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "valid_classes"}
SELECT DISTINCT customer_type 
FROM energy.all_class
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
class_data |> 
  dplyr::rename(class = customer_type) |> 
  dplyr::filter(!c(class %in% valid_classes$customer_type) & class != "Entered Total")
```

Model outliers that warrant a follow up. 

```{sql connection=db, output.var = 'utility_type_table', echo = FALSE}
/*Query the customer class data from the data warehouse.*/
SELECT i.mn_utility_id AS utility_id, i.utility_type
FROM energy.utility_info i 

```

```{sql connection=db, output.var = 'county_sales', echo = FALSE}
/*
Query county level sales from the data warehouse. This will represent the proportion of sales from a given county, not the total MWH sold to each county.
*/

WITH total_mwh AS(
	SELECT utility_id, utility, report_year, mwh_delivered AS total_mwh
	FROM energy.all_class ac 
	WHERE customer_type = 'Total' /*AND report_year != 2023*/
)
SELECT c.utility_id, c.utility, c.report_year, c.county_name, (c.mwh_delivered / t.total_mwh) AS county_share
	FROM energy.county_sales c
	LEFT JOIN total_mwh t ON c.utility_id = t.utility_id AND c.utility = t.utility AND c.report_year = t.report_year
```


```{r, echo = FALSE}
data_path <- here::here("data")

data("county_gdp", package = "elecchecks")
#load(paste0(data_path, "/county_gdp.rda"))
#load(paste0(data_path, "/county_climate_regions.rda"))
data("county_climate_regions", package = "elecchecks")

county_sales <- county_sales |> 
  dplyr::left_join(county_gdp_table, by = c("report_year" = "year", "county_name" = "co_name")) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(gdp_share = as.numeric(gdp) * county_share) |> 
  dplyr::select(utility_id, utility, report_year, county_name, county_share, gdp_share) |> 
  dplyr::left_join(county_climate_regions, by = c("report_year" = "year", "county_name" = "county_name")) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(heating_degree_days_weighted = county_share * heating_degree_days, 
         cooling_degree_days_weighted = county_share * cooling_degree_days) |> 
  dplyr::select(utility_id, utility, report_year, county_name, county_share, gdp_share, heating_degree_days_weighted, 
         cooling_degree_days_weighted)

county_vars <- county_sales |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(utility_id, utility, report_year), names_from = county_name, values_from = county_share, names_prefix = "county_share_") |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(starts_with("county_share_"), .fns = ~tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)))


gdp_vars <- county_sales |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(utility_id, utility, report_year), names_from = county_name, values_from = gdp_share, names_prefix = "gdp_share_") |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(starts_with("gdp_share_"), .fns = ~tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)))

heating_vars <- county_sales |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(utility_id, utility, report_year), names_from = county_name, values_from = heating_degree_days_weighted, names_prefix = "heating_days_") |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(starts_with("heating_days_"), .fns = ~tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)))

cooling_vars <- county_sales |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(utility_id, utility, report_year), names_from = county_name, values_from = cooling_degree_days_weighted, names_prefix = "cooling_days_") |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(starts_with("cooling_days_"), .fns = ~tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)))


combined_data <- class_data |> 
  dplyr::left_join(county_vars, by = c("utility_id" = "utility_id", "utility" = "utility", "report_year" = "report_year")) |> 
  dplyr::left_join(gdp_vars, by = c("utility_id" = "utility_id", "utility" = "utility", "report_year" = "report_year")) |> 
  dplyr::left_join(heating_vars, by = c("utility_id" = "utility_id", "utility" = "utility", "report_year" = "report_year")) |> 
  dplyr::left_join(cooling_vars, by = c("utility_id" = "utility_id", "utility" = "utility", "report_year" = "report_year")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(utility_type_table, by = "utility_id") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(customer_type = as.factor(customer_type), 
                customer_count = as.integer(customer_count)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(utility_type = as.factor(utility_type)) 

```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
#subset data for modelling

data_model <- combined_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(!c(utility %in% c("Xcel Energy", "Great River Energy")), 
                !c(customer_type %in% c("Industrial", "Total", "Irrigation")), 
                complete.cases(utility_type), 
                mwh_delivered != 0) |> 
  dplyr::filter(customer_type != "Entered Total") 

#load workflow

mwh_model <- readRDS(paste0(data_path, "/linear_mwh_model.rds"))

mwh_results <- stats::predict(mwh_model, new_data = data_model) |> 
  dplyr::bind_cols(stats::predict(mwh_model, new_data = data_model, type = "conf_int")) |> 
  dplyr::bind_cols(data_model |> dplyr::select(utility, utility_id, mwh_delivered, utility_type, customer_type, customer_count, revenue)) |>
  dplyr::select(utility_id, utility, mwh_delivered, .pred, .pred_lower, .pred_upper, customer_type, customer_count, revenue)

``` 

These utilities have entries that are significantly different than would be predicted. Some may have entered incorrect units (KWH instead of MWH).
Note: Xcel Energy and Great River Energy have been excluded from the model. Industrial, Total, and Irrigation customers are not checked, but issues may exist there as well. 

```{r, echo = FALSE}
outliers <- mwh_results |> 
  dplyr::filter(mwh_delivered > .pred_upper | mwh_delivered < .pred_lower) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(maybe_unit_issue = dplyr::case_when(
    abs(((mwh_delivered / 1000) / .pred) - 1) < .5 ~ TRUE, 
    TRUE ~ FALSE
  ), 
  .pred = round(.pred), 
  .pred_lower = round(.pred_lower), 
  .pred_upper = round(.pred_upper)) |> 
  dplyr::relocate(maybe_unit_issue, .before = utility) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(utility)

DT::datatable(outliers)
```
